waiting_time.leakage_note: Excluded target average_waiting_time_minutes from features. Used chronological holdout (no shuffle). Same-day OPD/staff features retained as operational drivers of waiting time.

all_models.selection_rationale: Selected by lowest RMSE on the chronological holdout, then MAE, then highest R2. RMSE emphasises large waiting-time misses.

selected.selection_rationale: Selected by lowest RMSE on the chronological holdout, then MAE, then highest R2. RMSE emphasises large waiting-time misses.

opd_forecast.note: Holdout metrics are from a model fit on data before the holdout. Saved artifact is refit on the full series for future 7-day forecasts.

anomaly_detection.score_note: anomaly_score is -decision_function (higher = more anomalous). anomaly_flag=1 means IsolationForest predict==-1.
